products.title: PDRN Youthful Dewy Glow Routine
products.description: Three steps, one active. Salmon DNA — polynucleotide, or PDRN — runs through the serum, the face cream and the eye cream, so skin gets the same repair-focused ingredient at every layer of the routine rather than in a single step. PDRN is the K-beauty ingredient behind the “salmon DNA facial” treatments. In topical form it works alongside the supporting cast in each formula: vitamin C and ferulic acid for radiance, snail mucin filtrate and shea for barrier comfort, peptides and ginseng around the eye. What's inside PDRN Salmon DNA Vitamin C E Ferulic Serum — 1 fl oz. The brightening step. Sodium DNA with sodium ascorbyl phosphate, vitamin E and ferulic acid, plus Korean ginseng, gotu kola and green tea. Helps even the look of tone and smooth the appearance of fine lines. PDRN Salmon DNA Snail Mucin Face Cream Moisturizer. The barrier step. Snail secretion filtrate, organic shea butter, avocado and jojoba oils, panthenol and a touch of retinol. Deeply moisturizing, and supports the skin barrier so the complexion feels soft and comfortable. PDRN Salmon DNA Lifting Firming Eye Cream — 0.5 oz. The delicate step. A gentler concentration for the eye area, with palmitoyl peptides, CoQ10, cucumber and eyebright to hydrate and help improve the look of firmness. Who it's for Anyone wanting to bring PDRN into a full routine instead of testing it in one product — and anyone whose main concerns are loss of firmness, dullness, or fine lines that show first around the eyes. Suits all skin types, including sensitive skin, though a patch test is always worth doing first. Cruelty free. Formulated without parabens, sulfates or phthalates.

products.description: Unlock the secret to a flawless, youthful complexion with our most comprehensive and effective K-beauty regimen.
